title: Vertebroplasty for osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures: paired sham-control trials, patient improvement, and boundary-sensitive de-adoption
summary: Promotes vertebroplasty as a boundary-sensitive procedure-reversal record. Two 2009 sham-controlled trials found no vertebroplasty-specific benefit over simulated procedures in their studied populations, while later guideline, acute-fracture, kyphoplasty, and severe-pain distinctions require child records rather than a flat universal verdict.
